mentions.name: Foraging Map for Edible Fungi
mentions.description: A foraging map that correlates wood type, heat, temperature and other environmental factors to indicate where various edible fungi fruit. It includes bike trails, renders Mapbox Vector Tiles fast enough for mobile use, has been field tested at least once, and has no public version yet.
mentions.source_excerpt: Im putting together a foraging map which correlates wood, heat, temp, and whatnot to tell me where various edible fungi fruit. It is mostly working so far, has bike trails and we tested it at least once.
